name: mtxrInterfaceTable
description: General interface information. Values that are not available or not applicable for an interface are reported as zero (for numeric columns) or as an empty string.

.1.3.6.1.4.1.14988.1.1.24.1.1.1.name: mtxrInterfaceIndex
.1.3.6.1.4.1.14988.1.1.24.1.1.1.description: Interface index, same as used in ifTable

.1.3.6.1.4.1.14988.1.1.24.1.1.5.name: mtxrInterfaceMtu
.1.3.6.1.4.1.14988.1.1.24.1.1.5.description: Configured layer-3 MTU. 0 when MTU is set to auto or is not configurable for this interface.

.1.3.6.1.4.1.14988.1.1.24.1.1.6.name: mtxrInterfaceActualMtu
.1.3.6.1.4.1.14988.1.1.24.1.1.6.description: Actual layer-3 MTU currently used by the interface, same as ifMtu.

.1.3.6.1.4.1.14988.1.1.24.1.1.7.name: mtxrInterfaceL2Mtu
.1.3.6.1.4.1.14988.1.1.24.1.1.7.description: Layer-2 MTU (maximum frame payload the interface can handle without fragmentation). 0 when not supported by this interface.

.1.3.6.1.4.1.14988.1.1.24.1.1.8.name: mtxrInterfaceMaxL2Mtu
.1.3.6.1.4.1.14988.1.1.24.1.1.8.description: Maximum layer-2 MTU that can be configured on this interface. 0 when not supported by this interface.

.1.3.6.1.4.1.14988.1.1.24.1.1.9.name: mtxrInterfaceMacAddress
.1.3.6.1.4.1.14988.1.1.24.1.1.9.description: Interface MAC address, empty for interfaces without one

.1.3.6.1.4.1.14988.1.1.24.1.1.10.name: mtxrInterfaceFlags
.1.3.6.1.4.1.14988.1.1.24.1.1.10.description: Comma separated list of active interface flags: dynamic, disabled, inactive, running, slave, passthrough, power-limited

.1.3.6.1.4.1.14988.1.1.24.1.1.11.name: mtxrInterfaceLastLinkDownTime
.1.3.6.1.4.1.14988.1.1.24.1.1.11.description: Value of sysUpTime when the link last went down. 0 if the link has not gone down since last reboot.

.1.3.6.1.4.1.14988.1.1.24.1.1.12.name: mtxrInterfaceLastLinkUpTime
.1.3.6.1.4.1.14988.1.1.24.1.1.12.description: Value of sysUpTime when the link last went up. 0 if the link has not come up since last reboot.

.1.3.6.1.4.1.14988.1.1.24.1.1.13.name: mtxrInterfaceLinkDowns
.1.3.6.1.4.1.14988.1.1.24.1.1.13.description: Number of times the link went down

.1.3.6.1.4.1.14988.1.1.24.1.1.14.name: mtxrInterfaceVrf
.1.3.6.1.4.1.14988.1.1.24.1.1.14.description: Name of the VRF the interface belongs to, 'main' for the main routing table
